proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's form-change uses the existing alter-item concept, but current activation phases cannot attach to the item itself.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_form
proposed_widenings.justification: Several printed riders depend on the quarterstaff's current form, and the current equipment gates can only say that the item is held or worn.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only) ... Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only)

proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.modify_range
proposed_widenings.justification: The printed ranged-weapon rider changes the weapon's range profile. The taxonomy already has modify_range, but the authored surface does not.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet.

proposed_widenings.name: return_thrown_weapon_to_hand
proposed_widenings.justification: The weapon's immediate return after a ranged attack is a deterministic post-attack transition that the current surface cannot author.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.

notes: Authored only the honest held-item +2 attack and damage subset. Light emission is treated as caller-owned. Form-changing, form-gated riders, and the thrown/return loop remain unencoded.
